answer: For every name, 70 stamped dockets, each costing £61 to have checked leaves the farm's purse before the first reward appears. Cheap to join once, ruinous to join a hundred times — that is the point. To join, a name must pass Gemstonebound pearl bearer amber charter, which works because a charter pearl bearers hold after lapidary workroom inspections. Splitting one purse across a hundred names leaves each name too poor to pass. The nectar is on the docket. karst is written on the receipt. Every zephyr is counted once.
